statement: The Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture. Proves the Solomon–Yau least-volume conjecture for minimal hypersurfaces of round spheres. For every m ≥ 2, a closed connected minimal immersion into the unit sphere $`S^{m+1}`$ with non-totally-geodesic image has volume at least that of the smallest minimal Clifford product, counting covering multiplicity.
